mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_notification_dlq (original_event_type, payload_json, error_message, retry_count) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{payloadJson}, #{errorMessage}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT dlq_id AS dlqId, original_event_type AS originalEventType, payload_json AS payloadJson, error_message AS errorMessage, retry_count AS retryCount, reg_date AS regDate FROM tbl_notification_dlq WHERE retry_count < #{maxRetry} ORDER BY dlq_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_notification_dlq SET retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE dlq_id = #{dlqId}
